Since the graph must have 15 vertices, these conditions cannot be satisfied simultaneously, making the problem unsatisfiable.
cot_trace: We need a graph with many contradictory constraints. It says consists of exactly 2 vertex-disjoint cliques of size 3 (every vertex belongs to one of these cliques, and the only edges are within these cliques). That means only 6 vertices have edges, others isolated? But "every vertex belongs to one of these cliques" contradicts 15 vertices. So impossible. Hence UNSAT.
